text:
eli: quick heads-up: onboarding Siren-7B (Llama feedforward + Gemma-like attn) to Dedicated. Conversion + int4 quant completed but long-context summarization shows coherent drift after ~700 tokens — contradictory to short-context checks.
maya: stats?
eli: rouge-L down ~10 vs fp16 on our doc-summarize-5k benchmark; perplexity spike around token 700. Short docs fine.
jorge: typical triad: head-order, rotary freq, tokenizer mismatch. Any converter warnings?
eli: converter log snippet: 
```
WARN converter: detected interleaved_head_stride=3
INFO converter: applying default_rotary_base=10000
WARN converter: metadata: rotary_factors missing, using default
```
nora: interleaved_head_stride=3 is suspicious (we expect stride 1 or 2 on some exporters). If converter flattened without canonical permutation you'll see headwise projection mismatch.
maya: can you run per-head cosine similarity between fp16 reference and quantized attn outputs for a short shared seed?
eli: did that. Layers 6-9 mean ~0.82 cosine, others ~0.98+.
jorge: that's head shuffle. But the drift at ~700 tokens suggests rotary phase mismatch too. Do we know the source model's rotary base or per-layer scaling?
eli: model card had "rotary_bases": [10000, 5000] in notes but converter didn't consume that.
nora: so converter used 10000 everywhere; layers expecting 5000 will have phase scaling mismatch causing phase error that accumulates with pos index.
maya: try permuting to canonical head ordering and re-run with per-layer rotary base set where we think it's needed. Also tokenization: Siren has a nonstandard normalizer that folds U+200D in specific cases. Long docs that include user copy/paste content often include these.
eli: quick patch: enforced contiguous heads in converter and set layer 7-8 base=5000 per card guess, re-export + int4 calibrate. Preliminary: rouge-L improved by 7 pts but still -3 vs fp16.
nora: improvement but residual gap remains. Int4 quantization can interact badly with small rotary frequencies because q/k magnitude ranges shrink and uniform symmetric quant loses fidelity. Try per-channel scale on q/k/v/out for the attention matrices in the affected layers.
jorge: also check kv cache reconstruction error vs time: if phase mismatch remains, cosine similarity should decay with t.
eli: kv_cosine logs: 
```
layer7: t0=0.997 t256=0.964 t512=0.783 t768=0.492
layer13: t0=0.999 t256=0.998 t512=0.996 t768=0.995
```
maya: layer7 still decaying. That aligns with our guess.
nora: steps: 1) update converter to parse rotary_bases/rotary_factors from model card (and fallback to default only if absent) 2) add canonical head permutation with explicit mapping output (so runtime can verify) 3) add an int4 per-channel calibration mode for attention projections 4) add a preflight that runs kv_cosine checks up to t=1024 and fails onboarding if certain layers drop below threshold.
eli: small experiment: per-channel calibration on layer7 (q/k) recovered another 2.5 rouge pts. Combining per-layer rotary fix + per-channel quant got within ~0.7 pts of fp16 on average.
orge: (typo?) jorge: nice. We should also add a unit that checks tokenizer normalization on long inputs: generate synthetic long doc with varied Unicode joiners/zero-width chars and ensure token ids are stable vs reference.
maya: I'll open a PR on the converter to add rotary parsing and head perm export. Also adding checksum artifact with permutation mapping to the model tar.
ciabot: eli created branch "siren/rotary-headperm-calib" with 2 commits. CI queued.
eli: plan to run a canary on the dedicated cluster routing 8% traffic with synthetic long-doc probes every minute. If rouge-L drop >2.5 pts for 15m, rollback.
maya: also add a dashboard panel for kv_cosine per-layer so we can triage quickly next time.
ciabot: canary scheduled by ops (deploy window "2026-04-05T22:00:00Z").
eli: thanks team. will post results after the canary.
